projects.name: Bitcoin
projects.desc: The original decentralized currency — a peer-to-peer electronic cash system that requires no trusted third party. The bedrock of financial sovereignty.
projects.thesis: Bitcoin proved value can exist outside institutions, that trust can be mathematical, and that individuals can hold their own wealth without permission.

projects.name: Ethereum
projects.desc: A decentralized platform for smart contracts and applications. Programmable money, DAOs, and the infrastructure for a new internet.
projects.thesis: Ethereum is the canvas where communities build their own rules, economies, and governance — without asking permission from anyone.

projects.name: Solana
projects.desc: High-performance blockchain built for speed and scale. Sub-second finality, low fees, and a thriving ecosystem of DeFi, NFTs, and consumer apps.
projects.thesis: Speed matters for adoption. Solana brings blockchain to the speed of thought — making decentralized apps feel as fast as centralized ones.

projects.name: Chainlink
projects.desc: The decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to real-world data — the bridge between blockchains and the external world.
projects.thesis: For blockchains to interact with reality they need a decentralized truth layer. Chainlink is that layer.

projects.name: Celestia
projects.desc: The first modular data availability network. Deploy your own blockchain without the cost of building consensus from scratch.
projects.thesis: Modularity is sovereignty. Celestia lets communities build custom chains for custom purposes — your rules, your data, your consensus.

projects.name: Render
projects.desc: Decentralized GPU rendering network connecting artists and developers who need computing power with people who have GPUs sitting idle.
projects.thesis: Decentralizing compute is decentralizing power. Render turns GPU capacity into a shared resource — no gatekeepers, no cloud monopolies.

projects.name: Worldcoin
projects.desc: A global identity and financial network using biometric proof-of-personhood to distinguish humans from AI online.
projects.thesis: As AI grows, proving you're human becomes essential. Worldcoin asks how we preserve human agency in an age of intelligent machines.

projects.name: Helium
projects.desc: Decentralized wireless network built by people. Deploy hotspots to provide 5G and IoT coverage, earning tokens for contributing to physical infrastructure.
projects.thesis: Infrastructure owned by people, not corporations. Helium proves decentralized communities can build real-world networks from the ground up.

projects.name: Echo
projects.desc: Onchain capital formation platform for early-stage investing. Now part of Coinbase, Echo has facilitated $200M+ across 300+ deals since 2024.
projects.thesis: Echo democratizes access to early-stage deals once reserved for VCs and insiders. Community-driven capital formation infrastructure.

projects.name: Legion
projects.desc: Merit-based, MiCA-compliant ICO platform. Reputation scoring allocates investments — rewarding community involvement over wallet size.
projects.thesis: Your contribution to the ecosystem matters more than your capital. Merit-based fundraising aligned with building real community.

projects.name: Akash
projects.desc: Open-source decentralized cloud computing marketplace. Rent GPU and CPU compute at a fraction of centralized costs.
projects.thesis: The AWS of Web3. Akash offers permissionless compute — essential infrastructure as AI demand explodes and centralized clouds become bottlenecks.

projects.name: Pendle
projects.desc: Yield trading protocol that tokenizes future yield. Split any yield-bearing asset into principal and yield components to trade separately.
projects.thesis: Pendle brings fixed income to DeFi. Yield markets are massive in TradFi — Pendle is building that infrastructure on-chain.
